scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @dengueahead/api -w @dengueahead/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:integration --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
